name: obsidian-openyolo
description: Obsidian chat client powered by opencode via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP).

scripts.ob: osascript -e 'quit app "Obsidian"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && sleep 1 && open -a Obsidian --args --remote-debugging-port=9222 && npm run dev
scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && npm run styles:build && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.prettier:check: prettier --check --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.prettiercache src __mocks__ eslint.config.mjs postcss.config.cjs
scripts.prettier:write: prettier --write --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.prettiercache src __mocks__ eslint.config.mjs postcss.config.cjs
scripts.lint:check: npm run prettier:check && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.eslintcache src __mocks__
scripts.lint:fix: npm run prettier:write && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/.eslintcache --fix src __mocks__

author: Kamijoucen
